c-70451606ed07305d.texto: Marriages in the East are celebrated by processions of friends, who throng the streets and give noisy demonstrations of their joy. Singers and musicians accompany them, and the shouts and music are heard afar off. Miss Rogers gives a lively account of a wedding party she once met…

h-2d3e19182c22dd5e.texto: JFB: llamado profético en 629 a.C. (año 13 de Josías, cf. Jr 1:2); ministerio continúa tras la caída de Jerusalén hasta el exilio en Egipto.
